summary: Verified Homework Open->highlight fix. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass (topic without highlight excludes grade-mismatched item; with highlight injects it; /api/child/homework returns resolved topic_ids for all 3 seeded HW items; Candy Shop topic includes candy content). Frontend: logged in as classmate_g3, dashboard 'My Homework' widget shows 3 pending items ('3 to do'). Clicked Open on both worksheet/video HW and Start on the Candy Shop activity HW - all three navigated to /learn/topic/<topic_id>?highlight=<content_id> and rendered the homework-highlight-badge on the assigned item, including the grade-excluded worksheet (regression case).
critical_code_review_comments: ChildHomework.jsx renders a 'Start' button (data-testid=homework-start-<id>) for is_activity homework instead of 'Open' (data-testid=homework-open-<id>). The review spec referenced only homework-open-<id>; if QA/tests key off that testid pattern they will miss activity-type homework. Consider standardising testid to `homework-open-<id>` regardless of button label, or documenting both.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded HW items (hw_gradeexcl_test, hw_ae13b88455b0 (Testing), hw_c63a55c16008 (Candy Shop)).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint returns `session_token` (not access_token); backend accepts it via Authorization: Bearer <session_token> header OR session_token cookie. Topic detail response shape uses keys: topic, subtopics, content_items.
